extracted.intended_audience: NIH grant applicants, institutional research administrators, and grants office staff preparing NIH applications
extracted.subtask_description: Checklist of required form-version, field, attachment, and table changes applicants must follow for NIH application packages using FORMS-I (effective for due dates on/after Jan 25, 2025). Includes renamings, deleted/added attachments, table restructures, and updated OMB expiration dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition ID must be FORMS-I for due dates on/after Jan 25, 2025
rubrics_metrics.description: The National Institutes of Health (NIH) uses the ‘Competition ID’ field of Grants.gov application packages for quick and easy identification of the form versions used in an application package. NIH require the use of application packages with a Competition ID of ‘FORMS-I’ for due dates on or after January 25, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications prepared using “FORMS-H” application packages for due dates on or after January 25, 2025, may not be reviewed. Verify the Competition ID in Grants.gov before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use updated OMB expiration dates on PHS forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple PHS forms included in FORMS-I have updated OMB expiration dates (e.g., various PHS 398 forms). The document lists old (FORMS-H) and new (FORMS-I) expiration dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure you are using the FORMS-I versions that carry the updated expiration dates (managed by NIH under OMB 0925-0001) rather than older FORMS-H versions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Cover Page Supplement field label change
rubrics_metrics.description: Field label change from “Change of Grantee Institution” to “Change of Recipient Institution.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the new field label wording in any relevant parts of the cover supplement and related institutional-change documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form fields may be renumbered
rubrics_metrics.description: Form fields renumbered as needed across affected PHS forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check field numbers and references carefully when completing forms and when referring to attachments or instructions; do not rely solely on prior form field numbering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training Program: Recruitment Plan to Enhance Diversity (added then removed)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Training Program Section previously had an added “Recruitment Plan to Enhance Diversity” attachment to the Training Program Section; update March 2025: Attachment removed; no longer required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not include this attachment for submissions after the March 2025 update; verify current requirements at time of submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form: section and attachment renamings
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple renamings and structure changes: “Fellowship Applicant Section” renamed “Candidate Section”; “Applicants Background and Goals for Fellowship Training” attachment renamed “Goals, Preparedness, and Potential”; in Research Training Plan Section, attachments “Specific Aims”, “Research Strategy”, “Respective Contributions”, and “Selection of Sponsor and Institution” replaced with “Training Activities and Timeline”, “Research Training Project Specific Aims”, and “Research Training Project Strategy.”
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the updated section names and attachment titles when assembling fellowship applications and ensure attachments match the new labels and organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form: sponsor/mentoring section restructuring
rubrics_metrics.description: “Sponsor(s), Collaborator(s), and Consultant(s) Section” renamed “Commitment to Candidate, Mentoring, and Training Environment”; “Sponsor and Co-Sponsor Statements” attachment renamed “Sponsor(s) Commitment”; “Description of Candidate’s Contribution to the Program Goals” attachment moved into this section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide sponsor commitment and candidate contribution materials under the updated section and attachment names and positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Fellowship Supplemental Form: removal of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training Section
rubrics_metrics.description: “Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training Section” removed including the “Description of Institutional Environment and Commitment to Training” attachment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not submit the removed institutional environment section or attachment; incorporate necessary institutional information elsewhere as directed by current instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report cleared separately with updates
rubrics_metrics.description: The included PHS Inclusion Enrollment Report is cleared as a separate form under OMB Number 0925-0770 with a new expiration date of 11/30/2027. Instruction text updated throughout the form; moved scientific areas of expertise field above list of individuals who should not review your application field.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the separate cleared Inclusion Enrollment Report (check OMB 0925-0770) and follow the revised instruction text and updated field ordering when completing inclusion data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training Data Tables: removal of redundancies and instruction clarifications
rubrics_metrics.description: All training data tables: Removed redundancies (not asking for structured data available elsewhere), updated table instructions (clarified terms, use of consistent lettering for training stage) and rationale, updated examples (current dates; wider variety of names, fields, and careers including research-related careers).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the clarified instructions and new examples; do not duplicate structured data that is collected elsewhere in the application package.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training Data Tables: optional partnership program structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Added optional structure for partnership programs (Tables 2 and 4).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your program involves partnerships, use the optional partnership structure in Tables 2 and 4 as appropriate to capture partner-specific data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table 5 reorganized to focus on trainee publication outcomes and allow interim research products
rubrics_metrics.description: Table 5 reorganized to focus on trainee publication outcomes (instead of participating faculty publication record). Allow applicants to include, as appropriate, interim research products which the trainee contributed to (such as preprints) when the final peer-reviewed publication is not already included on the table.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report trainee publication outcomes; include interim research products (e.g., preprints) when final peer-reviewed publications are not yet available, as appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Predoctoral and Postdoctoral tables: limit data collection to training stage and reduce burden
rubrics_metrics.description: Limited data collection to information for the training stage of the program to reduce burden (Tables 1 and 2). Removed most trainee characteristics from Table 6 to reduce applicant burden. Removed “Part II. Those Clearly Associated with the Training Grant” from Table 8.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide only training-stage data where requested; do not supply the removed trainee characteristics or the removed Table 8 Part II content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Undergraduate training tables: added census and renewal appointment table
rubrics_metrics.description: To align with data standards for other training grants, added Table 1: Census of Participating Biomedical Departments and Interdepartmental Programs; added Table 7: Appointments to the Training Grant for Each Year of the Current Project Period (Only for Renewals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For undergraduate training applications, complete the new Table 1 (department/program census) and, for renewals, Table 7 (appointments per project year).

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of Common Forms for Biosketch and Current & Pending (Other) Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Targeting by May 2025: Adopting Common Forms for Biographical Sketch and Current and Pending (Other) Support in line with Guidance for Implementing National Security Presidential Memorandum 33; reference copies of the Common Forms per OSTP memorandum on Policy Regarding Use of Common Disclosure Forms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare biosketch and current & pending support using the referenced Common Forms when they are adopted; consult OSTP/White House guidance and the provided reference copies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal-wide (Research & Related) forms largely unchanged; some expiration date updates
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH application packages also include federal-wide forms commonly identified as Research & Related or R&R. Grants.gov manages form updates and approvals for these federal-wide forms under OMB clearances 4040-0001, 4040-008, and 4040-0010. There are no changes to the federal-wide forms included in FORMS-I application packages, except as noted (e.g., updated expiration dates).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Confirm federal-wide R&R forms via Grants.gov; expect no substantive content changes in FORMS-I except where explicitly noted (for example, updated expiration dates for Project/Performance Site Locations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Project/Performance Site Locations(s) OMB expiration date update
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms Approved Under OMB Number 4040-0010: Expiration Date updated (old FORMS-H date 11/30/2025; new FORMS-I date 12/31/2026). Project/Performance Site Locations(s) listed with updated expiration date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the FORMS-I Project/Performance Site Locations form with the new expiration date when completing site location information.
